# Train / test split by session (Task 2 and Task 3: the paper's protocol)
TRAIN_SESSIONS=1,2,3,4
TEST_SESSIONS=5,6,7,8

# Task 1 (identification) only: train on 6 sessions (300 reps/user), test on the last 2 (100 reps/user)
# Task 1 is not compared against the paper, so it uses more (and more recent) training data.
# The sessions 1-4 / 5-8 run is kept in experiments/task1_split_comparison/.
TASK1_TRAIN_SESSIONS=1,2,3,4,5,6
TASK1_TEST_SESSIONS=7,8

# Task 2 protocol (Killourhy & Maxion, DSN-2009)
# Each user: train on their 200 reps from sessions 1-4, test genuine on their 200 reps from sessions 5-8
GENUINE_TRAIN_N=200
GENUINE_TEST_N=200
# Impostors: first IMPOSTOR_PER_USER reps of each of the other 50 users, taken from IMPOSTOR_SESSION
# Session 1 = the paper's protocol (needed to compare against the published EER table)
IMPOSTOR_PER_USER=5
IMPOSTOR_SESSION=1

SEED=42
